title: Every tracked path has one change class and every commit stays in one family
statement: Every tracked path MUST classify into exactly one change class declared in law/policy/change-taxonomy.json with a path bound to two classes rejected at policy load, and every commit MUST carry a subject of the form type(scope): subject whose type allows the classes of its paths and whose paths stay inside one change family except for the pairings the policy lists.
rationale: ADR-GOV-0017 and ADR-GOV-0018 make the governance and implementation families separable in history so authority by path (Article 6) survives the commit.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
